details.failure_summary: Timeout waiting for Manage Permissions modal elements (Open/Close modal, Add permission exception locators exceeded 5000–10000ms)
details.reasoning: The failure is a Playwright TimeoutError on UI locators for the Manage Permissions modal ('Open Manage Permissions modal', 'Close Manage Permissions modal', 'Add permission exception'). The test was retried 3 times and failed all 3 retries, but the sibling test 'test_no_access_permission_blocks_all_api_operations' — which likely interacts with the same modal — also had an initial FAIL screenshot before passing on retry. This pattern strongly suggests the Manage Permissions modal was intermittently slow/unresponsive during this specific CI run (possible backend slowness or UI rendering delay), rather than a product regression. All 24 other artifact tests passed. A clean rerun is warranted before escalating to INVESTIGATE.
